mechanism: One CTA per (speculative row,head) in one grid; same 256-thread strided max/sum and ordered 128/64/32 shared tree followed by exact warp16/8/4/2/1. Materialize expf(score-max) once in the existing score slot, reuse for unchanged division after same FP32 denominator. No online normalization or reassociation. QK/PV unchanged.

reference.translation: Study compute_qk retains exponentials for denominator and value consumption. Transfer lifetime reuse and batched query scheduling only; reject its online max/rescale/exp2 and reduction order for this exact verifier. Native implementation, no source import.

equivalence: Each original score is dead after max and its expf evaluation. A thread overwrites only its strided cells after the whole maximum tree; all original expf inputs/results and denominator additions/divisions remain bit-identical. Shared reductions preserve original 256-leaf topology, no changed root order; barriers protect root broadcast and scratch reuse. Causal lengths and row slots unchanged.
resources: No allocation/arena/sidecar changes; partial256 floats per CTA. Model/state/capacity/reserve untouched.
